items.question: Where did Quionche Carter play college basketball?
items.answer: Quionche Carter played four seasons at Walsh, where she set the program record with 2,116 career points and was twice the Great Midwest Athletic Conference Player of the Year. She then transferred to Florida Gulf Coast in 2022.

items.question: Did Quionche Carter play for the Phoenix Mercury?
items.answer: Yes. The Phoenix Mercury signed Quionche Carter in April 2026, and she made their opening-day roster. She played 13 regular-season games for Phoenix in 2026, averaging 1.2 points.
